summary: Build AI project delivery skills across agile, DevOps, risk analytics, and governance. Create practical dashboards and plans. Enquire today.
lede: AI-augmented project and portfolio management helps project, program, and PMO leaders coordinate complex transformations with human-reviewed AI support. The course shows how to create governed plans and dependency maps, assess delivery risks, and track benefits, with attention to data quality, stakeholder signals, and traceable human decisions.
audienceIntro: AI project delivery is relevant to professionals who coordinate complex initiatives, govern investment, or convert delivery evidence into decisions. The course suits mixed cohorts from corporate and public-service environments because the exercises focus on transferable controls, outputs, and stakeholder responsibilities rather than jurisdiction-specific rules.
prerequisites: You should have practical experience managing projects, programs, products, PMO reporting, transformation work, or portfolio decisions. Familiarity with agile delivery, project risk registers, and basic KPI reporting helps, but advanced data science or programming is not required. Completion requires no coding. You will work with facilitator-provided project datasets and templates in browser-based or spreadsheet-based exercises. Advanced predictive analytics, sentiment models, and AI governance are taught at conceptual and operational application levels, while participants design workflows rather than deploy production models.
